summary: Frontend-only testing of Bozzmail reservation flow (replaces previous waitlist). All 10 feature items pass on desktop (1920) and mobile (390). Live availability (admin reserved, 'ab' too short, 'John Doe' auto-lowercased/space-stripped to 'johndoe', unique handle shows checking->available), submit button enable/disable logic, happy path POST with success card + address + copy/share clipboard fallback with sonner toasts, taken-handle (409) response in band form, one-reservation-per-email error toast on cta form, invalid email error toast, nav-cta-button scrolling to #reserve, hero scroll state flip to 'off' with 'Turn OFF Surveillance' title and bright red bg-fighter (rgb(255,10,10)) submit button, announcement bar mentions reserving @bozzmail.com. Mobile 390x844: no horizontal overflow (scrollWidth=390), all three forms stack cleanly (width 358), @bozzmail.com suffix does not overlap typed text for a 19-char handle thanks to pr-[8.5rem].
critical_code_review_comments: ReserveForm.jsx submit does not client-side validate email format; relies on backend 400. Works but adds a round-trip; consider inline validation.
seed_data_creation: Created two reservations via UI happy-path tests: qa<ts>@bozzmail.com and qa<ts2>c<...> handles with example emails.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Reservation UI fully working. Three forms: hero-reserve, band-reserve, cta-reserve. Toasts are sonner (top-center). Clipboard works after context.grant_permissions(['clipboard-read','clipboard-write']). Hero scroll state toggles at ~1200px scroll (data-state='off', bg-fighter red button).
